plan.notes: Source: official University of New Orleans (LSU New Orleans) Department of Computer Science four-year plan page (http://www.lsuneworleans.edu/academics/cos/computer-science/undergraduate/four-year-plan); the page states it reflects the four-year plan of study for the current academic year. Catalog year 2026-2027 set 2026-09-30 (dept page = current academic year). Transcription method: fetched the dept page and transcribed the semester-by-semester table by hand; semester totals (13/13/17/16/15/15/16/15) sum to 120, matching the page's stated Total Degree Hours 120. Title verification: catalog.uno.edu course-description deep pages were unreachable (connection timeout, 2026-09-30), so titles were verified against other official UNO sources -- UNO Dept of Computer Science undergraduate/Minor page (CSCI 2120, 2125, 2450), cs.uno.edu CS course pages (CSCI 2467), the UNO Math catalog at www.uno.edu/academics/cos/mathematics/catalog (MATH 1125, 1126, 2114, 2124, 2314, 3721), UNO ScholarWorks institutional-repository syllabi (CSCI 1583, 1581, 2121, 3090, 3102, 4311, 4401), the UNO EE dept four-year plan and an official uno.edu transfer-degree PDF (ENGL 1157, 1158/1159, 2152; UNIV 1001 'Univ Success'), and the plan's own labels for elective slots. Caveats: the titles of CSCI 3080, CSCI 4000, CSCI 4101, CSCI 4125, and CSCI 4501 could not be verified on any official UNO page reachable on 2026-09-30 (the UNO ScholarWorks syllabi collection lists syllabi for CSCI 3080/4101/4125/4501, but the individual syllabus pages failed to load during verification), so they are entered as 'Course CSCI xxxx (title unverified)'. Unofficial corroboration exists -- 'Ethics in the Computing Profession' for CSCI 3080 (a UNO CS instructor's CV and an archived UNO catalog-text mirror), 'Analysis of Algorithms' (CSCI 4101), 'Database Systems' (CSCI 4125), 'Programming Language Structure' (CSCI 4501, archived catalog mirror) -- but none is an official department page, so the unverified form stands. CSCI 4000 is a required 0-credit course (required_zero:true); no official title was found on any source. Prereq data (official dept sources only): the dept Minor page states credit in CSCI 1583 is required for CSCI 2120, and credit in or concurrent enrollment in MATH 3721 is required for CSCI 2125 (both CSCI 2125 and MATH 3721 appear in the same Spring Year 2 semester of this plan); the cs.uno.edu course page lists CSCI 2120 and CSCI 2450 as prereqs for CSCI 2467. No other prereqs are transcribed (none invented). Student-choice slots are choice:true placeholders with the approved options described in choice_note; the two 'CSCI 3000 level or above elective' slots and all repeated elective labels use distinct slot codes. UNIV 1001 carries the dept plan's footnote 1 (required for all first-time full-time students; the page renders it as 'UNIV 10011'). Science sequence options per the official dept degree-requirements page: 6-hour sequence from BIOS 1073+1083 (recommended), CHEM 1017+1018, PHYS 1031+1032, or PHYS 1061+1062, with the corresponding labs; one science must be BIOS and the other CHEM, EES, or PHYS; 9 hours of science total. [2026-09-30: new file; id uneworleans-bs-computer-science distinguishes University of New Orleans (New Orleans, LA) from unomaha-bs-computer-science (University of Nebraska Omaha) -- both schools abbreviate to UNO.]
